description: Open-Meteo Historical Weather API. With models=era5 this is ERA5 reanalysis, not a forecast.
radiation_note: Open-Meteo shortwave, direct, diffuse and direct-normal values are the mean of the preceding hour. Temperature, humidity, cloud cover and wind are the value at the timestamp.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com, licensed CC BY 4.0 (https://open-meteo.com/en/licence). Requested with models=era5. ERA5 is produced by ECMWF for the Copernicus Climate Change Service and is also under CC BY 4.0.
note_sample: Small committed extract of one calendar month. Same columns as the full file under data/raw or data/processed. start_date and end_date, when present, are the range of that full download.
